In this petition, the petitioners are seeking quashing of the order dated 13.11.2014 passed by the learned J.M.F.C., Saintala in G.R. Case No.2 of 2014 arising out of Saintala P.S. Case No.2 of 2014,
whereby the learned Court below has taken cognizance of the offences under Sections 420/506/34 of I.P.C. against the petitioners.
3.
The interim order in the present case is operating since 27.06.2016.
This matter was also dismissed for non-filing of postal requisites and subsequently, it was restored.
4. When the matter is taken up today, none appears for the petitioners.
5. In the interest of justice, list this matter on 08.10.2024.
6. Interim order passed earlier shall continue till the next date.
7. It is made clear that on the next date of hearing, if learned counsel for the petitioners would seek Rudrasish Nath & Others vs State Of Odisha ....
